meta.head: 56cb6ef0
meta.notes: Focus on findings the 2026-11-23 run missed; re-verifies ARQ-001 closed. No remote CI executed.

top_risks: ARQ-010: doc-refs gate RED (16 dead file:line citations in security docs)
ARQ-011: stale line citations in security docs after lib.rs shrank
ARQ-002: AmatlService God Object impl of 1541 lines (open, pre-existing)

findings.title: The doc-refs gate exits red: 16 dead file:line citations
findings.description: tools/check_doc_refs.py exits 1 on a clean tree. static-analysis.yml job doc-refs runs it as a blocking step on any push/PR touching crates/**, docs/**, README.md or SECURITY.md.
evidence: crates/amatl-server/src/lib.rs is 3369 lines; all 16 citations reference ranges >= 3385
None of the 16 (doc,path) pairs are in FROZEN (only 8 frozen pairs, all external/historical)
findings.why_it_matters: Permanent red gate for virtually any product PR; the blocking gate loses signal, same anti-pattern the repo already fixed for cargo fmt and cargo audit.
findings.repair_status: REPAIRED 2026-11-24 (software-repair-engineer): all 16 citations re-anchored to current lines with symbol names; gate now exits 0
findings.root_cause_commit: 44b44e64 (retire answer/strategist surface shrank lib.rs by ~170 lines)

findings.title: Security-doc line citations are stale; referenced controls still exist
findings.description: The dead references point to valid files with obsolete line ranges, not missing code. Cited controls exist at new line numbers.
evidence: http-hardening.md:56 cites lib.rs:3385-3394 (constant-time compare) -> real fn constant_time_eq at lib.rs:3206
http-hardening.md:46 cites lib.rs:3474-3492 (CORS) -> real fn cors_layer at lib.rs:3305
http-hardening.md:40 cites lib.rs:3396-3416 (Host) -> real fn valid_host at lib.rs:3217
http-hardening.md unmodified since 2026-10-26; retirement commit is 2026-11-22
findings.why_it_matters: Security documentation is the audit evidence for controls; an auditor following the citation reaches a wrong line/EOF instead of the control.
findings.repair_status: REPAIRED 2026-11-24: citations re-anchored, including content-drifted refs (secured, metrics, status, health, api_error, query rejection)

findings.title: AmatlService is a God Object: single impl of 1541 lines
findings.description: crates/amatl-core/src/service.rs:466-2006 is one impl AmatlService covering search, batch, pagination, deep, persistence, credentials, canaries, provider governance, cache, history, saved and status.
evidence: amatl-server/src/lib.rs (3369 LOC) replicates the pattern: ~45 handlers + AppState + auth + ratelimit + metrics
findings.why_it_matters: SRP violation at type level; highest cross-regression surface; existing config/ sub-module precedent was not applied to service.

findings.title: No automated code-coverage metric despite a 70% goal
findings.description: 699 tests exist and docs/testing.md declares a 25-row capability matrix, but no line coverage measurement or threshold runs in CI.
evidence: asymmetric granularity: core 492 tests / server 153 / cli 25 / ui 29
findings.why_it_matters: Without a reproducible number the real debt cannot be shown; UI (1904-line app.js) and CLI are at the low end.

findings.title: config/mod.rs at 2527 LOC without full decomposition
findings.description: The root Config type, its assembly and free validation functions concentrate in config/mod.rs though 10 sibling sub-modules already exist.
findings.why_it_matters: Second largest module; natural candidate for config/validate.rs and config/patch.rs.

findings.title: UI contract validation depends on opt-in browser assets not covered by Rust tests
findings.description: Presentation logic lives in ~2500 lines of vanilla JS embedded via include_bytes!; the 29 Rust tests cover the host, not the JS behavior, whose primary check is the opt-in browser-e2e suite.
evidence: browser_e2e.rs only runs with AMATL_BROWSER_E2E=1; CI job exists but a driver-less checkout stays green
findings.why_it_matters: Large surface with primary verification outside the default gate; docs+CLI have coherence tests, the JS<->API contract does not.

findings.title: Tracked evaluation artifacts of 3-5 MB; .git at 41 MB
findings.description: docs/evaluation/independent-relevance tracks several multi-MB JSON and a 1.6 MB tracker-domains.txt.
findings.why_it_matters: Heavier clones/diffs; appears intentional for reproducibility, so add a short ADR decision.

findings.title: A few commits outside Conventional Commits
findings.description: Some messages in the last 300 are free prose; the repo otherwise follows a disciplined conventional scheme with security:/release:/ci: types.

findings.title: Three TODO(1.0) alias-removal markers without formal tracking
findings.description: local_model_batch alias removal TODOs lack an ADR; prior run added a CHANGELOG 'Removals planned for 1.0' section.
findings.why_it_matters: Well-scoped but could survive to 1.0; very low.
findings.repair_status: VERIFIED 2026-11-24: the 3 TODO(1.0) are already tracked in CHANGELOG 'Removals planned for 1.0'; no change needed.

strengths_verified: Dependency DAG: core does not import server/ui/cli; server->core+ui; cli->core+server
Fail-closed required_scope by method+path; public exemption limited to GET|HEAD
Constant-time credential comparison (SHA-256 digests), config_write_lock serializes config writes
OpenAPI<->router coherence enforced by test guards
19 ADRs; 9 security docs; C4 + sequence diagrams
Secrets from env only; amatl.toml/.env/sqlite/logs not tracked
deny.toml suppresses exactly 2 advisories, each ADR-backed and re-derived each run
Numbered SQLite migrations 0001-0008 with downgrade/ and MIGRATION_VERSION=8

roadmap.title: Re-anchor security-doc line citations
roadmap.problem: 16 dead file:line citations; doc-refs gate red
solution: Update citations to current lines (constant_time_eq:3206, valid_host:3217, valid_origin:3238, cors_layer:3305, required_scope:557, token_digest:530, security_middleware:2805)
Optionally FROZEN only the dated record hallazgos-2026-10-26.md, never the living docs

roadmap.title: Anchor the symbol, not just the line (drift prevention)
roadmap.problem: Next lib.rs prune will re-rot citations; checker cannot see semantic drift
solution: Cite symbol after the line e.g. lib.rs:3217 (fn valid_host)
Optionally extend tools/check_doc_refs.py to assert the token appears on the cited line

roadmap.title: Decompose impl AmatlService by concern
solution: Strangler: split into service/{search,deep,providers,storage,credentials}.rs with partial impl blocks
Preserve public struct + signatures and lib.rs re-exports
roadmap.success_criteria: no file > 1500 LOC; largest impl < 500 LOC

roadmap.title: Extract validation from config/mod.rs
solution: Move free validation fns to config/validate.rs and patch helpers to config/patch.rs; keep Config and re-exports in mod.rs

roadmap.title: Add code coverage to CI
solution: Publish summary with informative (non-blocking) threshold first
Then freeze blocking threshold and record the number in docs/testing.md

roadmap.title: Cover the JS<->API contract
solution: Keep browser-e2e fail-closed and add a non-browser payload-contract smoke test (validatePayload vs API shapes), or document the end-to-end-only coverage explicitly

roadmap.title: Decide heavy-artifact strategy
solution: Short ADR: track / Git LFS / regenerate; document the justification under docs/evaluation/

roadmap.title: Polish
roadmap.problem: Minor commit-message and TODO tracking gaps
solution: Confirm the 3 TODO(1.0) appear in CHANGELOG Removals planned for 1.0

executed: test and unwrap/expect counting with test-module masking
not_executed: full cargo test --workspace in this run
methodology.limitations: Findings rest on reproducible local commands and config/doc inspection; no remote CI results are claimed.
